note: A Newark mayoral contest was held on May 11, 2010. The only source for the vote totals is an Internet Archive copy of newarkelection2010.com. That site labels itself Unofficial and carries QLife branding, and no document from an election authority certifies it. The Essex County Clerk page View/30 has no Newark mayor table and says Newark results go to newarkelection2010.com. The archived site shows Booker 22745 and Minor 13570 as the top two, but no official or certified document was found. A search for another source was not completed because the web search budget and the Wayback CDX rate limit were exhausted. The year is left unresolved and no result is recorded. This pass: the Essex clerk page View/30 (last update 04/15/2016) was read again and still has no Newark mayor table, only the line 'FOR NEWARK RESULTS GO TO http://www.newarkelection2010.com'. A request to web.archive.org for newarkelection2010.com and its CDX index failed (no response, then SSL connection error), and the web search budget was exhausted, so no city clerk, council resolution or county canvass for the May 11, 2010 Newark mayoral result was found. The year stays unresolved.
